events.title: Escape the Flood Demo is out NOW!
events.summary: The water is already at your ankles. Now you can do something about it. The Escape the Flood early demo is live on Steam. Starting today, ahead of Next Fest. Wash ashore on an island that is going under. The ocean climbs, steadily and without pause, and it does not wait for you to be ready. Gather what the island gives you, craft tools and boat parts, build something that floats, and be on it when the ground runs out. events.title: Escape the Flood is coming to Steam Next Fest!
events.summary: The water is already at your ankles. And it is not stopping.Escape the Flood is a first person survival crafting game about a rising ocean. Wash ashore on an island, scramble to gather what you can while the beach disappears beneath you, craft tools and a raft, and escape before the flood takes everything. Play solo, or survive together in online co-op with up to 10 players.From October 19 to 26, you can play an early prototype during Steam Next Fest!This is an early prototype: content, features
